units.source_text: 日暮时分，惟光从东山回来参见公子。

en.t: At dusk, Koremitsu returned from Higashiyama and came to attend upon the young lord.

units.source_text: 这里因为公子对人宣称身蒙不洁，来客立谈片刻旋即退出，所以室内并无外人。

en.t: Because the young lord had told people that he was ritually unclean, visitors only stood talking for a short while and then withdrew, so there were no outsiders in the room.

units.source_text: 公子立刻召他入内，问道：“怎么样了？

en.t: The young lord immediately called him inside and asked, "How did it go?

units.source_text: 终于不行了么？”说着，举袖掩面而哭。

en.t: Was there finally no hope?" As he said this, he raised his sleeve to cover his face and wept.

units.source_text: 惟光也啼啼哭哭地说：“已经毫无办法了。

en.t: Koremitsu too spoke through his tears: "There is nothing more that can be done.

units.source_text: 长久停尸寺中，不当稳便。

en.t: It would not be proper or safe to leave the body in the temple for long.

units.source_text: 明日正是宜于殡葬的日子。

en.t: Tomorrow happens to be an auspicious day for the funeral rites.

units.source_text: 我有一个相识的高僧在那里，我已将有关葬仪一切事情拜托这高僧了。”

en.t: There is a high-ranking monk there whom I know, and I have entrusted all matters concerning the funeral to him."

units.source_text: 源氏公子问：“同去的那个女人怎么样了？”

en.t: Prince Genji asked, "What has become of the woman who went with her?"

units.source_text: 惟光答道：“这个人似乎也不想活了。

en.t: Koremitsu replied, "She too seems to have lost the will to live.

units.source_text: 她说：‘让我跟小姐同去！’哭得死去活来。

en.t: She cried, 'Let me go with my lady!' and wept as if she would die.

units.source_text: 今天早上她似乎想跳岩自尽，还说要将此事通知五条屋里的人，

en.t: This morning she seemed ready to throw herself from the rocks, and she also said she would tell the people at the house in Gojo about this matter,

units.source_text: 我百般安慰她，对她说：‘你暂且镇静下来，把前前后后的事情考虑一下再说。’

en.t: so I comforted her in every way and told her, 'For now, calm yourself and think over everything from beginning to end before you do anything.'

units.source_text: 现在总算没事。”

en.t: For the moment, at least, nothing has happened."

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了这话，悲伤之极，叹道：“我也痛苦得很！

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this, he was overcome with grief and sighed, "I too am suffering terribly.

units.source_text: 此身不知如何处置才好！”

en.t: I do not know what I should do with myself."

units.source_text: 惟光劝道：“何必如此感伤！

en.t: Koremitsu tried to console him, saying, "Why grieve so deeply?

units.source_text: 一切事情都是前世注定的。

en.t: All things are fated from previous lives.

units.source_text: 这件事决不泄露出去，万事有我惟光一手包办，请公子放心。”

en.t: This matter will never be leaked. I, Koremitsu, will handle everything myself, so please set your mind at ease."

units.source_text: 公子说：“这话固然不错。

en.t: The young lord said, "That is certainly true.

units.source_text: 我也确信世事皆属前定。

en.t: I too believe that all worldly affairs are predetermined.

units.source_text: 可是，我因轻举妄动，害死了一个人的性命，

en.t: But through my rash and reckless behavior, I have caused a person to lose her life,

units.source_text: 我身负此恶名，实甚痛心！

en.t: and it pains me deeply to bear such a terrible name.

units.source_text: 你切勿将此事告诉你的妹妹少将命妇；更不可教你家那位老尼姑知道。

en.t: You must not tell your sister, the Shosho Myobu, about this; still less must you let the old nun in your household know.

units.source_text: 她往常屡次劝谏我不可浮踪浪迹，如果被她知道了，真教我羞惭无地啊！”

en.t: She has often warned me not to wander about in frivolous affairs, and if she learned of this, I would be so ashamed I would have nowhere to hide."

units.source_text: 他嘱咐惟光保密。

en.t: He urged Koremitsu to keep the matter secret.

units.source_text: 惟光说：“外人自不必说，就是那个执行葬仪的法师，我也没有将真情告诉他。”

en.t: Koremitsu said, "Needless to say, I have told no outsiders; I have not even told the priest who is conducting the funeral rites the truth."

units.source_text: 公子觉得此人可靠，便稍稍安心。

en.t: The young lord felt that this man could be trusted, and he was somewhat reassured.

units.source_text: 众侍女窥见此种情状，都弄得莫名其妙，她们私下议论：“真奇怪，为了什么事呢？

en.t: The serving women, catching sight of this state of affairs, were all bewildered and whispered among themselves, "How strange. What can this be about?

units.source_text: 说是身蒙不洁，宫中也不参谒，为什么又在这里窃窃私谈，唉声叹气呢？”

en.t: He says he is ritually unclean and does not go to court, so why is he whispering here and sighing like this?"

units.source_text: 关于葬仪法事，源氏公子叮嘱惟光道：“万事不可简慢。”

en.t: Regarding the funeral and memorial rites, Prince Genji instructed Koremitsu, "Nothing must be done carelessly."

units.source_text: 惟光说：“哪里会简慢！

en.t: Koremitsu said, "How could I possibly be careless?

units.source_text: 不过也不宜过分铺张。”说着便欲辞去。

en.t: But it would also be improper to make things too ostentatious." With that, he was about to take his leave.

units.source_text: 但公子忽然悲恸起来，对惟光说：“我有一言，怕你反对：

en.t: But the young lord was suddenly seized by grief and said to Koremitsu, "There is something I want to say, though I fear you will object:

units.source_text: 我若不再见遗骸一面，心中总不甘愿。

en.t: if I do not see the body once more, my heart will never be satisfied.

units.source_text: 让我骑马前去吧。”

en.t: Let me go there on horseback."

units.source_text: 惟光一想，此事实在不好，但也无法阻止，答道：“公子既有此心，那也没有办法。

en.t: Koremitsu thought this was truly unwise, but he could not stop him, so he answered, "If Your Lordship feels this way, then there is no help for it.

units.source_text: 但请趁早出门，夜阑之前务须回驾。”

en.t: But please leave early, and you absolutely must return before the night grows late."

units.source_text: 源氏公子便换上最近微行常穿的那套便服，准备出门。

en.t: Prince Genji changed into the plain clothes he had recently worn on his secret outings and prepared to leave.

units.source_text: 此时源氏公子心情郁结，痛苦不堪，设想走这条荒山夜路，生怕遭逢危险，

en.t: At this time Prince Genji's heart was oppressed and his suffering was unbearable; thinking of taking that desolate mountain road by night, he feared he might meet with danger,

units.source_text: 一时心中踌躇不决。

en.t: and for a while he hesitated, unable to make up his mind.

units.source_text: 然而不去又无法排遣悲哀。

en.t: Yet if he did not go, he could not dispel his grief.

units.source_text: 他想：“此时若不一见遗骸，今后哪一世才能再见呢？”

en.t: He thought, "If I do not see her body now, in what future life will I ever see her again?"

units.source_text: 便不顾一切危险，带了惟光和那个随从，出门前去。

en.t: So, disregarding every danger, he took Koremitsu and that attendant with him and set out.

units.source_text: 只觉得路途遥远。

en.t: The road only seemed terribly long.
